phase: Phase 4: Pilot report, adversarial attack of the master merge
summary: The master merge holds. Every mutation that the brief named fails by name. These are the home year copy, the roadmap rule, APPROVED_SCHOOL_YEAR, the Thai month class, CONTAINER_STORY_IMAGES, and both new posts. The gaps are weak guards, not merge defects. The full suite passes at the audited head: 98 files, 1413 tests, exit 0. Six late findings go to tech-debt under the stop rule. ADV-25 needs a decision: a hard-coded home path would fail the www CI job. Verdict pass.
nonblocking_findings: ADV-25 [Late finding; suggested call tech-debt; the orchestrator may take the careful one-fix-round call] adversarial: src/__tests__/blog-posts-loader.adversarial.test.ts:77 builds a temp directory under the literal path /home/daniebo/.cache/opencode. That path exists on this machine only. mkdirSync with recursive true runs outside the try block. A user that cannot create /home/daniebo gets EACCES. The case 'surfaces a symlink to a directory named .md (ADV-22)' then fails. CI runs 'pnpm turbo run build lint check-types test --filter=www-reading-advantage...' on ubuntu-latest (.github/workflows/ci.yml), and the www test script is 'vitest run'. I did not run CI. Probe P14 is a proxy: the same call for a missing home directory failed here with EACCES. The sibling tests use mkdtempSync in the OS temp directory (blog-posts-loader-symlink.test.ts:32). The www CI job would fail at the later www push. A fix is a test-file edit, and a fix commit invalidates this result.

ADV-26 [Late finding; suggested call tech-debt] adversarial: the 2027 school year that master added to the home suite line has weak guards. P1: a changed year fails by name in en and zh, through the year class of the claims scanner. P11: a th year change from 2570 to 2571 passes all 1413 tests, because a Thai year never matches /20\d\d/. P9: removing the clause in en, th, and zh passes all 1413 tests, because no test asserts that the year is present. P11: a Thai 'STEM Advantage อยู่ในแผนงาน' passes. The new rule (www-batch-20261116.locale.test.ts:188-193) checks 'on our roadmap' and '暂无日期' in every locale. It checks no Thai phrase. Master guarded this line with the exact pin expect(home).toBe(expected.home) at 968bde612, and D5 removed that pin on the pilot side. The pilot asserts '2027' and '2570' on the badges, the roadmap note, and the six detail lines (www-batch-20261116.locale.test.ts:147-152, 228-233, 289-294), but not on pages.home.suite.description.

ADV-27 [Late finding; suggested call tech-debt] adversarial: expected copy data pins nothing, and the merge edited it. P11: noise in LABEL_COPY.en.home, LABEL_COPY.th.home, LABEL_COPY.zh.home, the en and th fields of ROW_B row 7, and OVERVIEW_LABEL_COPY.en.description leaves all 1413 tests green. Static search: no test reads the en, th, or zh field of any ROW_A or ROW_B row (www-batch-20261116.locale.test.ts:139-178 read only key and old). LABEL_COPY has one reader, '.en.navigation' at page.content.test.tsx:300. EXPECTED_META, EXPECTED_AUX_COPY, OVERVIEW_LABEL_COPY, PAGE_COPY, and IMAGE_ALT have no importer outside the fixture. Master changed three LABEL_COPY.home strings and the ROW_B home strings in 968bde612, so the strings look pinned and are not. P4: the school-year control (page.content.test.tsx:439) uses APPROVED_SCHOOL_YEAR.en as its own sample, so it passes for any value of the constant. P11: APPROVED_SCHOOL_YEAR.th changes nothing in the suite.

ADV-28 [Late finding; suggested call tech-debt] adversarial: the Thai month class has controls for 4 of 12 months (ธันวาคม, มกราคม, พฤษภาคม, and พฤศจิกายน through APPROVED_DATES.th). P5: deleting ธันวาคม fails by name. P11: deleting the other eight months passes all 1413 tests. A misspelled month name stays invisible. The pilot commit 733319505 added the class. The English class has a control for every month (page.content.test.tsx:188-202).

ADV-29 [Late finding; note; parity with the baseline] adversarial: P8: a YAML syntax error in one post fails blog-posts-validation.test.ts at collection and names no post. The other 16 rules do not run. The baseline 635a604c8 parsed every post at module scope with no catch, so the behavior is the same. The rule failures of P7 name the post. The report claim 'named in the failure' holds for rule violations, as proof-blog-merge.log shows.

ADV-30 [Late finding; note; static; not reproduced] adversarial: blog-posts-loader.adversarial.test.ts:39 and :56-58 write probe files into the real en posts directory. The probes are a .mdx file and an uppercase .MD file. blog-blocks.test.ts:210 sweeps that directory, blog-draft.test.ts publishedEnglishCount reads every entry of it, and blog-posts-validation.test.ts lists it. Under parallel files, an overlap would fail one reader. The strategy gate uses --maxWorkers=1, and the CI test script does not. P12: ten parallel runs of the seven files that touch the tree all passed.
